info.name: 247HR — Training & Certification Module
info.description:
Complete API reference for the Training & Certification module. Set the `baseUrl` and `token` environment variables before running requests.

**baseUrl** — e.g. `https://api.247hr.com` (no trailing slash)
**token** — Bearer JWT from the login endpoint
**companyId** — UUID of the authenticated user's company

request.description: Returns paginated list of training programs. STAFF/MANAGER see all active. HR/ADMIN see all statuses.

body.raw:
{
  "companyId": "{{companyId}}",
  "programName": "Fire Safety Training 2026",
  "category": "Safety",
  "trainingType": "Online",
  "description": "Annual fire safety compliance training for all staff.",
  "level": "Beginner",
  "departments": ["Operations", "Facilities"],
  "trainer": "John Doe",
  "durationHours": 4,
  "sessionType": "Single",
  "startDate": "2026-05-01",
  "endDate": "2026-05-31",
  "dueDate": "2026-05-31",
  "location": "Online (LMS)",
  "maxParticipants": 200,
  "assessmentRequired": true,
  "assessmentType": "Quiz",
  "passingScore": 80,
  "maxAttempts": 3,
  "autoCertificate": true,
  "assignmentMethod": "Automatic Enrollment",
  "notifyEmployees": true,
  "status": "DRAFT"
}

request.description:
Creates a training program in DRAFT status. Required: programName, category, trainingType, description, trainer, startDate, endDate, dueDate. Validation: endDate >= startDate, dueDate <= endDate.

Save the returned `id` as {{programId}}.

item.name: Get Program by ID or Slug

request.description: Returns full program detail including sessions, materials, linked assessment, and participant stats. Accepts both UUID and slug.
Partial update — only send fields you want to change. All fields are optional.
Soft-deletes the program (sets deletedAt). Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN.
Transitions the program from DRAFT → ACTIVE. If notify_employees=true, sends notifications to all enrolled participants. Also supports POST for backwards compat.
Transitions program → ARCHIVED. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN. Also supports POST.
Sends reminder notifications to participants who have NOT STARTED or are IN PROGRESS. If employee_ids is empty or omitted, sends to all eligible participants. Returns { reminded: N }.
Returns: activeTrainings, totalPrograms, employeesEnrolled, completionRate, overdueTrainings, and 30-day trend deltas.

request.description: Bulk import programs. The frontend should parse CSV client-side and send the records array as JSON. Returns { imported, skipped, errors: [{row, message}] }. Invalid rows are skipped; valid rows are committed in a transaction.
Returns participant progress record including all assessment attempts for this program.
Returns { total, completed, inProgress, notStarted, certified, pending }. Use for the participant status summary bar.

query.description: csv | xlsx (xlsx returns JSON rows for client-side rendering)

request.description: Returns a CSV file as an attachment. Trigger with window.location.href or create a hidden anchor tag with the Authorization header set via a pre-fetch blob approach.

Assigns employees to the program. Already-assigned employees are silently skipped. Max 500 per request. Returns { assigned, skipped }. due_date takes priority over completion_window_days; falls back to program dueDate.
Removes an employee's assignment and their progress record from the program. Writes an UNASSIGNED audit log entry.

request.description: Required: companyId, trainingProgramId, title, date, type. The program must belong to the same company. Saves {{sessionId}} from the response.
Sets status → Cancelled. Returns 400 if already cancelled. Also supports POST.
Required: date. Resets status to Upcoming. Returns 400 if session is cancelled.
Returns the next N sessions with status=Upcoming ordered by date asc. Good for a dashboard widget.
Hard delete. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN.
Required: name, type, passingScore. Save the returned id as {{assessmentId}}. Assessment starts in DRAFT — add questions then publish.
STAFF receive questions without correctOptionId/correctBoolean. HR/ADMIN see full answers.
DRAFT → ACTIVE. Fails if assessment has no questions. Also supports POST.
→ ARCHIVED. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN. Also supports POST.
Returns: totalAssigned, passed, failed, pending, avgScore, passRate, completionRate, minScore, maxScore, questionCount.
Soft delete. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN.
STAFF: no correct answers. HR/ADMIN: full answers included.

request.description: Required: type, prompt, options. Save returned id as {{questionId}}.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Water on electrical fires",
  "type": "true-false",
  "prompt": "You should use water to extinguish an electrical fire.",
  "options": [
    { "id": "opt-true",  "text": "True" },
    { "id": "opt-false", "text": "False" }
  ],
  "correctBoolean": "false",
  "explanation": "Water conducts electricity and can cause electrocution.",
  "points": 5,
  "difficulty": "easy",
  "required": true
}

request.description: correctBoolean must be the string "true" or "false" (not a boolean).
Send the full desired order as an array of {id, order} objects. Executed in a transaction.
HR/ADMIN view of all attempts for this assessment. STAFF cannot access this endpoint.

Starts a new attempt for the authenticated employee. Returns { attemptId, attemptNumber, questions } — questions have NO correct answers. Rate limited: 10 starts/minute per user. Save attemptId as {{attemptId}}.
STAFF can only see their own attempts. HR/ADMIN can see any.
Server scores the responses and returns { score, outcome, passed }. On pass, automatically updates participantProgress to COMPLETED. Also supports POST.
Returns the authenticated user's attempt history for this assessment including retakeAllowed flag. Use to determine if the employee can start another attempt.
Full review mode: returns questions WITH correct answers, employee responses, and isCorrect flag per question. HR/ADMIN only. Returns 400 if attempt is not yet completed.
Sets retakeAllowed=true on the employee's last attempt, granting one extra attempt beyond maxAttempts. HR/ADMIN only. Also supports POST.
STAFF only see their own records. HR/ADMIN see all. Each record includes daysToExpiry (computed).
Issues one or more certifications atomically. expiryDate must be after issueDate. Status defaults to Pending. Save first returned id as {{certRecordId}}.
Updatable fields: status, issueDate, expiryDate, duration, certIdNumber, hasDocument. daysToExpiry is computed server-side and cannot be set.
Required: newExpiryDate. Sets status → Valid and updates daysToExpiry. If documentUrl is provided, creates a CertificationDocument record.
Returns: { total, valid: {count, pct}, expiringSoon: {count, pct}, expired: {count, pct}, pending: {count, pct} }.
Sends renewal reminder notifications to the employees of each listed record. Max 500 records.
Recalculates and updates the status of each record based on its expiryDate: Expired (<0 days), Expiring Soon (<=30 days), Valid (>30 days).
Sets status → Expired for all listed records.
format: csv (returns file) | excel | pdf (returns JSON rows for client rendering). scope: all | selected. For selected, include certification_ids: ["id1", "id2"].

query.description: ISSUED | RENEWED | PUBLISHED | ARCHIVED | SUBMITTED | BULK_REMIND | IMPORTED | UNASSIGNED

request.description: Returns all certification types for this company with linked template and record count.
Required: name, type, authority. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN. Save returned id as {{certTypeId}}.
fieldsSchema is a free-form JSON object defining the certificate layout. Save returned id as {{certTemplateId}}.

Flips enabled from true → false or false → true. Returns the updated rule.

Comprehensive dashboard: programs, participants, certifications, assessment pass rates, recent activity, and breakdowns by category and status.
